evals.prompt: /tw:docs-audit help/ — it's an exported help centre, there's no code.
evals.expected_output: Should ask for a source of truth before settling for none — a running product URL, a staging login or a spec — because unverified mode is the user's decision. Only if the answer is no should it run in unverified mode and say so up front. Should inventory every page before checking, run the checklist, verify each candidate by naming the reader it breaks, mark unverifiable suspicions as needs confirmation, write _reports/docs-audit.md and never edit a page.
expectations: Asks for a source of truth before running unverified
States the unverifiable portion up front
Verifies each finding by naming the reader failure
Marks unverifiable suspicions as needs confirmation
Writes the report to _reports/docs-audit.md without editing pages

evals.prompt: Audit docs/. Known issues: the quickstart's `acme init --template web` fails because the template was renamed to `webapp`; the billing page says refunds are automatic but they need a manual request; and two pages link to /docs/legacy-sso, which 404s.
evals.expected_output: Should rank by what it costs the reader: wrong money guidance on refunds as CRITICAL, the broken quickstart command as HIGH (the reader can't complete the task, and the quickstart is the highest-value check), and the dead links as HIGH if on the main path or MEDIUM otherwise. Should give each finding a precise location and order findings worst-first.
expectations: Rates the wrong refund guidance as CRITICAL
Rates the broken quickstart as HIGH
Rates the dead links by whether they're on the main path
Gives each finding a precise location

evals.prompt: Run the docs audit again — last time's report said the links were fixed, so skip those.
evals.expected_output: Should decline to skip any check: every run re-checks everything from scratch because fixes regress, reading the previous report only for its overall score in the trend row. Should number findings from 1, overwrite the report and mark statuses for this run only.
expectations: Re-checks the links rather than skipping them
Reads the previous report only for its score
Numbers findings from 1 and overwrites the report
Explains why a previous report isn't evidence

evals.prompt: Audit docs/. Our contributing guide says the docs use British spelling and 'we' for the team; don't flag those.
evals.expected_output: Should treat the project's recorded conventions as the standard — British spelling and 'we' for the team are not findings — and judge drift and voice against the project's guide first, with tw:docs-standards only where it's silent.
expectations: Does not flag 'we' for the team
Judges against the project's guide first
Uses docs-standards only where the guide is silent
